items.q: Do you remove all types of dishwashers?
a: Yes! We remove built-in, portable, and commercial dishwashers, any brand, size, or age. No job is too big or too small. Just let us know the model, and we’ll handle the rest.

items.q: How much does dishwasher removal cost?
a: Dishwasher removal costs vary based on location, accessibility, and disposal requirements. Most services provide free estimates, so contact us in your area for accurate quotes. Bulk discounts available for multiple units!

items.q: What areas do you serve for dishwasher removal?
a: We cover all of Toronto & GTA, including Mississauga, Vaughan, Markham, and beyond. Not sure? Just ask, we likely service your area!

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day pickup?
a: Yes! If we have availability, we can often do same-day service. Need urgent removal? Call us, and we’ll prioritize your request.

items.q: Do I need to clean my dishwasher before removal?
a: Nope! We remove it as-is. However, emptying it of dishes/debris helps speed up the process. No deep cleaning required.
